[[File:Rebel_Event_Organizer.jpg|260px|thumb|right|A Rebel Event Organizer during the [[Remembrance Day]] in [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]].]]
A '''Rebel Event Organizer''' was an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] in charge of organizing various pro-Rebel events during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. One such officer was tasked with overseeing a [[Remembrance Day]] celebration on the planet [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] around the time after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]. The Event Organizer sold various Rebel rations, including [[Favorites of the Force]] and the energy drink [[Death Star Destruction]]. Because of the Rebels' [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|war]] against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the organizer turned away anyone he suspected as being Imperial-aligned.<ref name="SWG:ED">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=event|Empire Day}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Rebel Event Organizer was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:ED" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Imperial Celebration Organizer could be found near the [[Statue of Yoda]] in [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]], where he would sell various Empire Day related consumable items such as the [[Favorites of the Force]] and [[Death Star Destruction]] to players who were affiliated with the Rebels. The Rebel equivalent was the [[Imperial Celebration Organizer]].<ref name="SWG:ED" />
